current_stage_goal: Use the strongest current Mini Entity implementation as the executable bootstrap while making every new delta converge toward minimal EntityOS plus request-scoped HCU Function Fabric.
transition_laws: Mini Entity remains the operational go starting point and must not be discarded in favor of a parallel rewrite.
Mini Entity is not the final product identity; EntityOS plus HCU is the architectural destination.
Zero trends toward universal cognitive ingress/admission rather than persistent persona.
Entity trends toward causal/state/authority coherence rather than anthropomorphic identity.
HCU cells trend toward request-scoped logical function slots rather than persistent mini-agents.
No permanent standing world simulation is the target; task-local consequence estimation and counterfactual reasoning remain allowed.
Global J-Space remains an empirically instrumented coupling hypothesis; local J-Space claims require model-specific causal evidence.
Hyperposition preserves unresolved alternatives; majority vote cannot mint truth.
Real effects remain deterministic, journaled and gated.
current_frontier: Improve and stabilize the current Mini Entity while preferentially selecting deltas that reduce migration cost toward Zero -> Entity <- Function: ingress/persona separation, function-cell semantics, request-scoped topology, J-Space instrumentation, Hyperposition/calibration, and effect non-bypass.
go_contract: Every go refreshes current main and newest owner authority, starts from the strongest current Mini Entity implementation, selects the highest-information nonduplicate Mini Entity blocker or capability delta, applies GRF hypotheses/counterhypotheses/falsifiers, preserves exact evidence and safety boundaries, and prefers changes that make eventual EntityOS + request-scoped HCU migration easier. It must not create a permanent world simulation, second identity, second durable truth store or second effect path.
legacy_scope: Frank and ClayVerse are historical/donor evidence. Mini Entity is current go bootstrap material, not the final standalone product.
